title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program Business Office Terms: First Installment on an Earlier-Year Balance
content:
**Clause.** An installment arrangement under the Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program works on the earlier-year enrollment's open balance on the day of the payment. The open balance is every charge posted on the enrollment less every payment, Workforce Solutions remittance and credit posted on it. The first installment is the whole open balance, the arrangement having one installment, rounded to the nearest cent, half a cent rounding up. Nothing is due when the open balance is not above zero.

**Order of the terms.** The arrangement's terms work together in one order:

1. The installment count is the number the term that sets a number gives. The installments that the adding terms give are added to it, and the installments that the subtracting terms give are taken off. The count is never fewer than one.
2. The term that sets how the first installment is worked out then acts on that count.
3. The first installment never exceeds the open balance, and it is rounded once at the end.

## What enters the open balance

| Increases the open balance | Decreases it |
|---|---|
| registration fees, tuition charges, day fees, late pickup fees, late payment fees, plan change fees, returned payments, returned payment fees, refunds disbursed | family payments, Workforce Solutions Child Care Services remittances, credits |

## Worked figure (hypothetical earlier-year enrollment)

Charges of 1,396.00 were posted over the year, and payments, remittances and credits of 1,227.50. The open balance is 168.50. With one installment, the first installment is 168.50. An earlier-year enrollment whose credits equal its charges has an open balance of zero, and nothing is due.
